location: Random rare loot drop from containers/enemies in any base-game zone
notes: Not automatically known even by Imperial-race characters for crafting (Imperial Edition only unlocks the look for the Outfit System for free, not the crafting motif itself). Motif 10 book/chapters drop rarely as world loot; also purchasable in Guild Stores.

location: Crown Store (periodic limited-time re-releases, e.g. Jan 15-22 2026 for ~1050 crowns)
notes: One of the original 'rare style' motifs sold as a Crown Store pack (available 2015-2017, later returned intermittently). No known reliable in-game farm; copies can be resold on Guild Stores by players who bought it from the Crown Store.

location: Containers (desks, dressers, trunks, wardrobes, backpacks) in Cadwell's Silver zones (opposing alliance veteran zones)
notes: Also sold via Crown Store historically as a 'rare style' pack. Requires completing the other two alliances' main quests to unlock Cadwell's Silver access. Low drop rate from containers.

location: Containers (desks, dressers, trunks, wardrobes, backpacks) in Cadwell's Silver zones (opposing alliance veteran zones)
notes: Also sold via Crown Store historically as a 'rare style' pack. Low drop rate from containers.

location: Random rare loot drop from any base-game zone container/enemy
notes: Base-game motif, chapters found as random world loot across Tamriel; also purchasable in Guild Stores. (Note: this is the original base-game Daedric Style, distinct from the newer 'Ancient Daedric Style' which is an Antiquities/Deadlands scry-and-excavate motif.)

location: Dwarven pots/urns and chests inside Dwemer ruins (Craglorn, Bangkorai, Wrothgar, etc.)
notes: Chapters looted from Dwarven-themed containers in various Dwemer ruin delves across multiple zones, not one single location. Also purchasable in Guild Stores.

location: Purchase full book from Rolis Hlaalu (Master Writs merchant) for 180 Writ Vouchers
notes: Individual chapter fragments (10 needed per chapter + Merethic Restorative Resin) can also drop from daily crafting writs; fragments tradeable via Guild Stores. Also periodically in Crown Crates/Crown Store.

location: Trophy Vaults in the Imperial City open-world zone (bought from Tur using Imperial Fragments dropped by enemies in the Sewers/Districts)
notes: Not an instanced dungeon — Imperial City is an open PvE/PvP hybrid zone; the Trophy Vaults are vendor-style rewards purchased with Imperial Fragments, not a dungeon boss drop. Guild Store purchase possible for players without Imperial City access.

location: War Researcher vendors in Cyrodiil (one at each Border Keep)
notes: Purchased with Alliance Points.

location: Mystery Coffers sold by Undaunted vendors (Maj al-Ragath, Glirion the Redbeard, Urgarlag Chief-bane) at any Undaunted Enclave
notes: Chapters are a random possible drop from purchased Pledge Masters' Mystery Coffers (gold currency), not a guaranteed buy. Crafting requires Laurel.

location: Reward for completing repeatable daily quests in Craglorn
notes: Also purchasable in Guild Stores; complete book has appeared as a Crown Crate legendary reward.

location: Rare drop from enemies/containers in the public dungeons Old Orsinium and Rkindaleft (Wrothgar)
notes: Chapters split evenly between the two public dungeons; must farm both. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward and directly purchasable in Crown Store.

location: Repeatable daily delve quests for Guruzug in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar
notes: Reward from daily delve-clearing quests, not a guaranteed drop every time.

location: Repeatable daily world boss quests in Wrothgar
notes: Reward from daily world boss quests (paired with Trinimac's delve dailies).

location: World/delve bosses in Hew's Bane (e.g. Krona Keeba in Shark's Teeth Grotto, Magnifico Bahraha in Bahraha's Gloom, Syvarra of the Deep in Ko Estaran, Captain Virindi Slave-Taker in Thrall Cove)
notes: Specific chapter pieces drop from specific bosses (helms/legs/shields/shoulders/staves from Krona Keeba; boots/bows/chests/maces/swords from Magnifico Bahraha; axes/belts from Syvarra; daggers/gloves from Virindi). Rarely also from Reacquisition Board coffers in Daggerfall Thieves Den. Requires Rogue's Soot to craft.

location: Treasure Chests in Cyrodiil/Imperial City (only opens for Aldmeri Dominion members)
notes: Alliance-locked motif; only accessible to characters in that alliance via PvP zone chests. Style material is Eagle Feather, purchasable from Siege Merchants (10,000 AP) or Tel Var Merchants (1,000 Tel Var Stones).

location: Treasure Chests in Cyrodiil/Imperial City (only opens for Daggerfall Covenant members)
notes: Alliance-locked motif. Style material is Lion Fang, purchasable from Siege Merchants (10,000 AP) or Tel Var Merchants (1,000 Tel Var Stones).

location: Treasure Chests in Cyrodiil/Imperial City (only opens for Ebonheart Pact members)
notes: Alliance-locked motif. Style material is Dragon Scute, purchasable from Siege Merchants (10,000 AP) or Tel Var Merchants (1,000 Tel Var Stones).

location: Delve/World Bosses, locked Treasure Chests, and Treasure Maps in Craglorn
notes: Multiple random-drop sources within Craglorn zone. Crafting requires Ancient Sandstone.

location: Cadwell's Silver (completing the Silver questline in any alliance zone)
notes: Motif book mailed automatically upon completing Cadwell's Silver (~25 quests). No DLC required. Style itself crafts using Azure Plasm from Dark Anchors/Dark Fissures.

location: Reward containers from daily quests given by Beleru Omoril and Traylan Omoril, Hall of Justice, Vivec City (Vvardenfell)
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Buoyant Armiger Crown Crates). Crafting requires Boiled Carapace.

location: New Life Festival Boxes (New Life Festival event only)
notes: Outside the festival window, chapters can only be bought via Guild Stores from players who obtained them during the event. Crafting requires Wolfsbane Incense.

location: Large Laundered Shipment boxes from completing highest-tier Thieves Guild Tip Board quests (Hew's Bane)
notes: Rarely also from the Reacquisition Board in Daggerfall Thieves Den. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward and directly purchasable in Crown Store. Crafting requires Polished Shillings (from pickpocketing guards).

location: Professional Thief's Satchel of Laundered Goods, reward for completing Heists within the time limit (Thieves Guild DLC, Hew's Bane)
notes: Random chapter reward from timed Heist quests.

location: World/delve bosses in Gold Coast (Ironfang in Garlas Agea, Exulus in Hrota Cave, Limenauruus in Tribune's Folly, Knight Commander Panthius in Kvatch Arena)
notes: Different armor slot chapters drop from different named bosses. Also purchasable in Guild Stores without Dark Brotherhood DLC.

location: Rakkhat, final boss of Maw of Lorkhaj trial (Normal/Veteran; guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode)
notes: Also available weekly from the 'Into the Maw' weekly quest coffer, and as a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Scalecaller/Unfeathered crates). Crafting requires Defiled Whiskers.

location: Reward from completing Dark Brotherhood Sacraments/daily quests (Gold Coast)
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Reaper's Harvest Crown Crates). Crafting requires Black Beeswax.

location: Purchase full book or chapters from Rolis Hlaalu (Master Writs merchant) using Writ Vouchers
notes: Requires rank 10 in Metalworking/Tailoring/Woodworking passive to read. This is the classic base-game Ebony style.

location: Reward from Fighters Guild dailies, Mages Guild dailies, and Undaunted delve dailies
notes: Rare chance from multiple different daily quest reward pools rather than one specific source. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Dwarven Crown Crates) and purchasable in Guild Stores.

location: Small chance from the Minotaur world-boss bounty quest via the Kvatch Bounty Board (Gold Coast)
notes: Bounty Board in Kvatch randomly offers either the Kvatch Arena quest or the Minotaur world boss quest; only completing the Minotaur quest has a chance at this motif page. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Dwarven Crown Crates).

location: Small chance from completing the Kvatch Arena quest via the Kvatch Bounty Board (Gold Coast)
notes: Alternatively the complete book has been sold directly in the Crown Store (historically ~4,000 crowns) and as a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Dwarven Crown Crates).

location: Weekly reward coffers for clearing Craglorn trials (Aetherian Archive, Hel Ra Citadel, Sanctum Ophidia)
notes: Possible chapter drop (or rarely full book) from the weekly trial completion reward coffer.

location: Witches Festival Writs (Witchmother's Whistling Wickerflask event) — each writ grants a Witchly Gift with a random chapter
notes: Previously chapters were sold in Witches' Festival event currency bags from the Impresario; now tied to event-specific crafting writs. Event-limited.
Chance on Normal/Veteran, higher chance on Veteran Hard Mode. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward, purchasable in Crown Store.
Possible drop on Normal/Veteran, guaranteed drop on Veteran Hard Mode. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward.

location: Treasure chests around Vvardenfell and within Halls of Fabrication trial
notes: Chance improves with the 'Champion of Vivec' achievement. Also sold directly in Crown Store and as Legendary Crown Crate reward (Reaper's Harvest Crown Crates).

location: Reward containers from daily quests given by Huntmaster Sorim-Nakar or Numani-Rasi in Ald'ruhn (Vvardenfell), unlocked after 'Ancestral Ties' and 'Ashlander Relations' quests
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Reaper's Harvest Crown Crates). Requires Morrowind DLC or ESO Plus.
Purchasable with Alliance Points from Battlegrounds vendors, unlike most other Vvardenfell house/faction motifs.

location: Pickpocketing NPCs or looting Safeboxes/Thieves Troves within Vvardenfell
notes: Random-chance loot from pickpocketing and lockboxes across the zone rather than one fixed spot.

location: Pickpocketing NPCs or looting Safeboxes/Thieves Troves within Vvardenfell
notes: Same acquisition method as Telvanni/Redoran — random chance loot across Vvardenfell.

location: Pickpocketing NPCs or looting Safeboxes/Thieves Troves within Vvardenfell
notes: Same acquisition method as Telvanni/Hlaalu — random chance loot across Vvardenfell.
Chance on Normal/Veteran, better odds on Veteran Hard Mode. Crafting requires Bloodroot Flux.
Chance on Normal/Veteran, better odds on Veteran Hard Mode. Crafting requires Minotaur Bezoar.

location: Daily quests for Novice Holli, Clockwork Facilitator, or Razgurug in Brass Fortress (Clockwork City DLC) — 'Slag Town Coffer' reward
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Hollowjack Crown Crates); Guild Store purchasable without the DLC.

location: Daily quests for Novice Holli, Clockwork Facilitator, or Bursar of Tributes in Clockwork City — 'Crow-Touched Clockwork Coffer' reward
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Hollowjack Crown Crates); Guild Store purchasable without the DLC.
Chance on Normal/Veteran, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Celestial Crown Crates).
Chance on Normal/Veteran, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also periodically sold directly in Crown Store.
Tied to the yearly Anniversary Jubilee event; also purchasable via Guild Stores outside the event window. Crafting requires Desecrated Grave Soil.

location: Random drop from activities throughout Summerset (chests, world content, fishing, etc.)
notes: Drop chance scales with rank in the Psijic Order skill line — higher rank greatly increases odds. Crafting requires Vitrified Malondo.

location: Daily quests for the Divine Prosecution and interacting with Psijic Portals in Summerset
notes: Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Diamond Anniversary Crown Crates) and directly purchasable when that crate is available.

location: Dremora Plunder Skulls during the Witches Festival
notes: Purchasable in Guild Stores outside the festival window.

location: Fishing (Pyandonean Bottles), Treasure Chests, and Psijic Portals in Summerset
notes: Multiple random sources within Summerset zone. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Psijic Vault Crown Crates).
Chance on Normal/Veteran; better odds on Veteran Hard Mode.
Chance on Normal/Veteran, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also a Legendary Crown Crate reward (Dark Chivalry Crown Crates); Guild Store purchasable without the DLC.

Farm Welkynar Style Motif Fragments (10 needed per chapter) from Z'Maja, the final boss of Cloudrest, on Veteran (guaranteed some fragments) or Normal with all three Welkynar Shades present. Fragments are combined with a Welkynar Binding obtained once per week from the repeatable quest 'Woe of the Welkynars' in the trial.

Blackrose Prison is a 4-player instanced arena (wave-based, five rounds x five arenas), not a Group Finder dungeon. Chapters drop from the final boss; higher chance on Veteran. Also periodically offered in Crown Store/Crown Crates.
Reward crates from repeatable dailies: Tribal Armor Crate (Varo Hosidias, Lilmoth), Grand Tribal Armor Crate (Bolu, Lilmoth), Tribal Treasure Crate (Tuwul, Root-Whisper Village).
Same reward crate pool as Dead-Water (Tribal Armor/Grand Tribal Armor/Tribal Treasure Crates) from Murkmire dailies for Bolu, Varo Hosidias, and Tuwul.
Chapters drop from the final boss (Stone Husk/Vault Guardian) with increasing chance on higher difficulty. Also occasionally sold in Crown Store.
Possible drop from final boss Symphony of Blades on Normal/Veteran; guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Elsweyr Daily Merit Coffer reward from repeatable World Boss/Delve daily quests for Ri'hirr and Nisuzi in Rimmen.
Elsweyr Dragon Hunter's Coffer reward from the repeatable Dragon Hunt daily quest given by Battlereeve Tanerline in Rimmen.
Possible page drop from final boss Nahviintaas (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from Dragon God's Time-Worn/Pristine Hoard weekly reward for completing 'The Return of Alkosh'.
Possible reward from Dragon Hunt/Delve daily quests given by Chizbari the Chipper and Dirge Truptor. Complete book also appeared as a Crown Store/Crown Crate legendary reward.
Possible drop from final boss Maarselok, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also sold in Crown Store and as Celestial Crown Crates legendary reward.
Possible drop from final boss Grundwulf, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also sold in Crown Store.
Possible drop from final boss Assembly General (guaranteed on Veteran Hardmode), or from the weekly quest 'Forging the Future' given by Divayth Fyr.
Senchal Reward Chest from delve/World Boss daily quests given by Bruccius Baenius and Guybert Flaubert.

Unlocked via the Dragonguard Operative achievement (30 Dragonguard-related quests, including main Dragonhold story and dailies). Once unlocked, chapters come from the daily Dragonguard Supply Chest (one open per day, 14 chapters total).
Possible drop from final boss Mother Ciannait, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Kjalnar Tombskald, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also periodically in Crown Store and Stonelore Crown Crates.
Reward containers from delve and World Boss daily quests; speak to Hidaver and Tinzen in Solitude to start the dailies.
Obtained from Harrowstorm daily quests (Swordthane Jylta) and from Reliquary Remnants left after quelling a Harrowstorm event in the world.
Possible drop from final boss Lord Falgravn (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from Kyne's Mundane/Gleaming Coffer weekly reward for 'The Fight for Kyne's Aegis'.

Requires the Antiquities skill line (unlocked via Greymoor). Leads drop from treasure map chests in EP zones (Bleakrock Isle, Shadowfen, Stonefalls, The Rift, Eastmarch, Bal Foyen, Deshaan); chapters are then excavated as antiquities.
Requires Antiquities skill line. Leads drop from treasure map chests in DC zones (Alik'r Desert, Stros M'Kai, Rivenspire, Glenumbra, Betnikh, Stormhaven), then excavated.
Requires Antiquities skill line. Leads drop from treasure map chests in AD zones (Khenarthi's Roost, Greenshade, Auridon, Malabal Tor, Reaper's March, Grahtwood), then excavated.
Possible drop from final boss Lady Thorn, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also periodically in Crown Store and Wraithtide Crown Crates.
Possible drop from final boss Arkasis the Mad Alchemist, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Requires Antiquities skill line and Blackwood. Leads drop from Blackwood treasure map chests, then excavated as antiquities.
Requires Antiquities skill line and High Isle. Leads drop from High Isle treasure map chests (also from High Isle Coffers during the Legacy of the Bretons event), then excavated.
Requires Antiquities skill line and Markarth. Leads drop from treasure map chests in The Reach, Blackreach: Arkthzand Cavern, and Western Skyrim, then excavated in The Reach.
Markarth Reward Coffer from Harrowstorm daily quests for Nelldena in Markarth, or directly from Reach Harrowstorm events. Also periodically in Crown Store.
Reward from delve/World Boss daily quests for Bralthahawn and Nelldena in The Reach.

Drops from the Wayward Guardian's Cache, awarded for completing daily quests from Ardanir in Markarth (unlocked after the Reach main quest 'A Feast of Souls'). Also has a chance as a Tales of Tribute daily victory reward. Drop rate widely reported as very low.
Reward from Saraathu Tong or Gleaners of Aurbis daily quests, or delve dailies from Luna Beriel, in Fargrave.
Possible drop from final boss Baron Zaudrus, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also periodically in Crown Store and Mirrormoor Crown Crates.
Possible drop from final boss Pyroturge Encratis, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Leyawiin Reward Coffer from daily group boss quests given by Britta Silanus.
Possible drop from final boss Xalvakka (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from the weekly quest 'Of Stone and Steam' given by Dust-On-Scales.
Occasional reward from delve daily quests given by Deetum-Jas in Blackwood.
Requires Antiquities skill line and Deadlands. Leads drop from Deadlands treasure map chests, then excavated as antiquities.
Possible drop from final boss (Magma Incarnate), guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also periodically in Crown Store and Buoyant Armiger Crown Crates.
Possible drop from final boss Prior Thierric Sarazen, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.

Possible chest reward after defeating the final boss (e.g. Havocrel Duke of Storms) at the end of a random Oblivion Portal event in the Deadlands. Limited to one style page per account per day (resets with daily crafting writs).
Deadlands Reward Coffer from World Boss daily quests given by Vaveli Indavel in Fargrave.
Possible drop from final boss Captain Numirril, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Varallion, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Tideborn Taleria (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from the weekly coffer for completing 'Reavers of the Reef' (Admiral Galvendier quest line).
Reward from World Boss daily quests given by Parisse Plouff in Gonfalon Bay.
High Isle Reward Coffer from delve daily quests given by Wayllod in Gonfalon Bay.
Possible drop from final boss Archdruid Devyric, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Zelvraak the Unbreathing, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Reward from Volcanic Vent daily quests given by Druid Aishabeh in Vastyr, and directly from completing Volcanic Vent world events; also occasional bonus loot from Antiquities excavation in High Isle.
Galen Reward Coffer from delve/World Boss daily quests given by Juline Courcelles and Druid Gastoc.
Possible drop from final boss Matriarch Lladi Telvanni, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Valinna, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode. Also reported as a rare drop from Trophy Vault (undaunted key) chests.
Possible drop from final boss Ansuul the Tormentor (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from the weekly trial coffer for completing 'The War Within'.
Necrom Reward Coffer from delve daily quests (Ordinator Tilena) or World Boss daily quests (Ordinator Nelyn) in Necrom.

Bastion Nymic is a non-instanced public dungeon (no group-finder queue). Chance to drop from its final boss and its daily coffer (from Ordinator Tandasea in Necrom); also from Psijic Portals on the Telvanni Peninsula and from Antiquities excavation in Apocrypha. Drop is capped at one per account per day.
Possible drop from final boss Aradros the Awakened, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss the Blind, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Skingrad Reward Coffer from delve/World Boss daily quests given by Commandant Salerius and Lieutenant Agrance; also occasional drop from Psijic Portals and Antiquity dig sites in West Weald.
Skingrad Reward Coffer from daily quests given by Legionary Jaida, or directly from completing Mirrormoor Incursion world events.
Possible drop from final boss Xoryn (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from the weekly trial coffer given by Keshargo in West Weald.
Not farmable in-game. Buy directly for 100 Crown Gems, or 3,600 Seals of Endeavor (earned via in-game activities, no real money required for that route). Complete book unlocks all pieces at once.
Possible drop from final boss Squall of Retribution, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Orpheon the Tactician, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.

Drops from Incursion Chests looted after defending Solstice Siege Camps, and from Reward Coffers for the 'Battle for the Writhing Wall' daily quests. Some early reports of very low/inconsistent drop rates on release.
Possible drop from final boss Overfiend Kazpian (guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode), or from the Ossein Cage weekly trial coffer.
Reward from delve daily quests (Lector Volonaro) and World Boss daily quests (Morlia) in Sunport; also occasional drop from Psijic Portals and Antiquities excavation in Western Solstice.
Possible drop from final boss High Soulbinder Vykand, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Possible drop from final boss Talen-Lah, guaranteed on Veteran Hard Mode.
Coffers from completing daily quests off the Reacquisition Board (or more rarely the Heist Board) in the Daggerfall Thieves Den. Players reported low drop rates shortly after release.
